Claim 1. (Currently Amended) An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, __wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from and more urgent than the first alarm__.

Claim 16. (Currently Amended) A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, __and an escalation status indicating whether the alarm has been escalated__; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data.

Claim 17. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system.

Claim 18. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, __wherein the level of escalation is determined based on whether the alarm has been acknowledged and a time elapsed since the alarm was triggered__.

Claim 19. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm, __including a timestamp of when the acknowledgement was received__.

Claim 20. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices __only when the alarm has not been acknowledged within a predetermined time period__.
